_comment: Classes used in ng-zorro templates that antd v6 CSS does not style. `input`/`select`/`space` entries are temporary: remove each one once the component's template is aligned with antd v6.
_button_comment: button's entries are permanent, not pending alignment: antd v6's own React Button emits ant-btn-color-link and the legacy ant-btn-{default,dashed,link,text,dangerous,rtl} type/danger/rtl classes for backward compatibility, but its v6 CSS never styles them (verified against node_modules/antd/es/button/style). class-coverage.spec.ts pins this exact set so it can't silently grow.
_skeleton_comment: antd-emits: -avatar-square, -button-square (shape classes v6 CSS never styles). v4-compat: -content (kept next to -section)
_spin_comment: v4-compat, all four styled by style/v6/patch.css mirrors until v6 is default
_result_comment: v4-compat: -content kept next to -body. antd-emits: -403/-404/-500 (exception-status root classes antd's own React component emits; v6 CSS never styles them, the icon renders as an SVG illustration instead)
